_comment: Hand-curated tier-1 name -> College Scorecard INSTNM. Normalization alone matches 233/274 US schools (85%); these close the remainder. Flagship/main campus is chosen where a system has several. Fuzzy matching is deliberately not used: at this scale a wrong automatic match is worse than a manual entry. Schools absent from Scorecard entirely are listed in _unmatched below and stay null rather than being force-matched. Note that INSTNM is not stable across releases: UNITID 196060 has been 'University at Albany', then 'SUNY at Albany', and is 'University at Albany' again in the 2026-06-10 file. A refresh that reports a school unmatched is usually a rename, not a closure - check the new file for the UNITID before assuming the school is gone.
California Polytechnic State University,: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
Columbia University: Columbia University in the City of New York
Cooper Union: The Cooper Union for the Advancement of Science and Art
Louisiana State University: Louisiana State University and Agricultural & Mechanical College
New England Conservatory: The New England Conservatory of Music
North Carolina State University: North Carolina State University at Raleigh
Olin College of Engineering: Franklin W Olin College of Engineering
Virginia Tech: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University
American Academy of Dramatic Arts: American Academy of Dramatic Arts-New York

_unmatched._comment: Genuinely absent from the Scorecard institution file, or ambiguous enough that a manual match would be a guess. These keep editorial values with honest nulls for observed fields.
_unmatched.Boston Conservatory at Berklee: merged into Berklee College of Music, which is already a separate row in tier 1; mapping both would double-count one institution
_unmatched.Mills College at Northeastern: merged into Northeastern; no standalone row
